mentions.name: Telegram DeepSeek R1 Chat Bot
mentions.description: A Telegram bot that lets users chat with the Microsoft DeepSeek R1 post-training model for free, using OpenRouter's free API key for that model. It is intentionally basic, without incremental streaming or multi-chat support, and can generate code.
mentions.source_excerpt: I had also created a project which you can chat with the microsoft deepseek r1 post training bot for free because the api key of open router for this model is free, It doesn't have incremental streaming or multi chats, really basic
